oracle: And so my fellow Americans ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
placement_verdict: WASM wins for this model on the JFK fixture: 14.88 RTFx against 2.63 on WebGPU, about 5.6x. The encoder is a small conv subsampler plus Conformer and does not benefit from the GPU; the autoregressive decoder is launch-bound.
frontend_note: Raw 16 kHz samples. The model config declares feature_size 1 and do_normalize false, so there is no mel frontend and no normalization.
decoder_contract: The graph returns self-attention history only: 13 outputs for 6 layers.
Cross-attention key and value are computed once from the encoder states and stay constant for the utterance.
The checkpoint EncoderDecoderCache order differs from the graph input names, so the seed is mapped by name.
export_note: The PyTorch encoder does not trace under the available exporter, and torch 2.13 defaults to the dynamo exporter which needs onnxscript. The browser fp32 pair is validated by tools/moonshine-onnx-export/export_moonshine_onnx.py rather than re-exported.
scope: Local artifact source only. No validated Hub export, so supportsHubSource is false.
not_covered: Streaming or partial-result behaviour is not measured; the model runs here as whole-utterance decode.
One fixture and one configuration each; no repeat-stability sweep beyond the recorded runs.
